verdict.rationale: GitBook's docs explicitly document 'Reusable content' as a first-party feature ([gitbook-docs-26]) alongside 'Content variants' ([gitbook-docs-20]), directly matching the story of reusable snippets and variables keeping content in sync. This is corroborated by the block-based editor and version-control ecosystem ([gitbook-docs-3], [gitbook-docs-24]) that would propagate such content updates. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of the reusable-content or variants feature specifically (community evidence is mostly about older/legacy GitBook CLI, not this feature).
